description: LocalEngine (plan §13.1, §15.1; Phase 3 session G, decisions 166-170, 174, 176, 186-) over TestCompositionRoot: the real services, StepRegistry.standard() and LocalEngine over the test kit's fakes. The world: a manual clock at 2026-10-02T20:00:00.000Z; files in memory, every volume 1 TB free; the data folder /root/data (config.json there); SQLite in a temporary folder (restart reopens it); the library lib at /root/library with its marker; the configuration {"version": 3, "libraries": [{"id": "lib", "name": "Library", "path": "/root/library"}]} unless given.config replaces it; makemkvcon at /tools/makemkvcon and mkvmerge at /tools/mkvmerge unless given.makemkvcon/mkvmerge is false (given.makemkvVersion is makemkvcon's version); EngineFacts {version test, pid 4242, platform macos, dataDir /root/data, cores 8}. Drives: the OS lists /dev/disk4 (HL-DT-ST BD-RE WH16NS60, mounted at /Volumes/MOVIE_DISC) and /dev/disk6 (MATSHITA DVD-R UJ8C2), video unless given.content {device: audio|data}; MakeMKV's drive scan (makemkvcon info disc:9999) prints given.scan, else the BD drive drv-86920bcfd062b640 with MOVIE_DISC and the DVD drive drv-de63b28f402c2eb5 empty. makemkvcon info prints the generated listing of {volume MOVIE_DISC, type bluray, one title 1:40:00 with 12 chapters, 30 GB}; other runs print nothing and exit 0. given.holds lists the makemkvcon commands (info, mkv, backup) that run until they are stopped; given.stopTakes (seconds) is how long a stopped process takes to end. given.slowMarkerRead makes every whole read of a library marker take 0.3 s of real time, given.slowDriveScan the first drive scan. given.jobs are stored before the first start (ids 00000000-0000-4000-8000-100000000001 ...): {name, title, state, driveId, mediaGeneration, automatic, rows [{kind, state}]}, plus given.finishedJobs finished jobs created before them; new jobs count from 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001. given.folders and markers {folder: library id} are made in memory. expect.steps, in order: start; stop (the test root's); restart (stop, build on the same database and files, start); settle (until the executor's activity is the held processes'); call {call: operation, args, as (names the job a JobDto result is), expect (a subset of the result's JSON; arrays match in length), error {code, params}} where a job argument is a job's name and {name} in strings is its id; feed {after, jobLog [names]} as; next (a feed: its next event, expect [subset or null]; seqIsLast: the event's seq is the bus's last; jobCount; firstJob); drain (a feed: every event until none comes, jobLogsOf: the jobs whose jobLog events came); seq (names the bus's last seq); stopBegins (the root's stop, not awaited, then 50 ms) and stopEnds (awaits it); monitoring (whether the fake device monitor is started); timers (the manual clock's timers not cancelled); fail {op, path} (that FileSystem operation fails with fs.failed {operation, path, reason injected}); unfail; unmount / mount (a path: the test root's); limitsOf {config, cores} (SchedulerLimits.of); engineLog [the engine log's lines {code, params}, exactly]; processes [the makemkvcon runs other than drive scans, as 'info <source>' or 'mkv <source>']; trayCalls [the fake drives' tray calls]; files {exist, absent}; stored {job: subset of its stored record}; released {executorStopped, processesRunning} (what the root's release saw); systemSeqIsLast (system().eventSeq is the bus's last).
